Then co-driver, is the perfect stepping stone for you! As a co-driver at bidfood in Utrecht, you will head out daily with the truck driver to various restaurants and canteens. Together, you drive a Bidfood truck through your region and deliver orders to our customers. You always work with a driver, and together you make it a fun ride.  what we offer  Gross hourly wage of € 15,20  Working the early/day shift  Opportunities for advancement within the company!  Travel allowance of € 0,23 per km  Free freshly prepared lunch and dinner  € 5,04 coffee money per day  who you are As a co-driver you meet the following requirements: - You speak good Dutch and/or English. - You are physically fit and have demonstrable experience with physically demanding work (for example, in construction, logistics, or removals). - You hold a B driving license and are willing to obtain a C driving license. - You are available full-time and have no problem working from Monday to Saturday. - You can be on location within 30 minutes using your own transport (e-bike, scooter, car).  what will you do As a co-driver, you are the face of our company. You are on the road all day, but make no mistake: this is not a quiet drive through the countryside. You drive short routes with many stops, constantly getting in and out to unload goods. It is physically demanding work where lifting and hauling are the order of the day. - At the end of the day, you return the truck to Bidfood in Utrecht and hand over the reports to your team leader. - Together with the driver, you load the truck with products for our customers...

To succeed as a CE Truck Driver, you are reliable, safety-conscious and comfortable working independently as well as part of a team. - You are in possession of a CE driving license, code 95 and a digital driver card. - You have experience with a tractor/trailer combination. - A flexible, service-oriented attitude and a strong focus on quality. - Good communication skills and willingness to work alternating early and late shifts. - You are fluent in English.
